mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as observed in historical data.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level shows no correlation with 20-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% indicates a weakening labor market, which typically precedes reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0% occurs in more than 60% of instances where 20-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC between UNRATE (above threshold) and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS occurs in more than 60% of instances where 20-day forward returns are negative, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO decline does not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for INDPRO decline in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals an elevated inflation environment, which typically triggers monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% occurs in more than 60% of instances where 60-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL (YoY > 3.0%) and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and positive GDPC1 occurs in more than 60% of instances where 20-day forward returns are negative, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO level shows no correlation with 20-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative when INDPRO is above 104 in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% signals weakening consumer spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS decline > 0.5% MoM occurs in more than 60% of instances where 5-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC between RSAFS decline (MoM > 0.5%) and returns is below 0.03.
